description: W-KEY-001 (Warning): a Tier-0 loop over `Item[]` with no header `key`; the rows render.
rationale: §17.4b: "When no `key` is declared, the compiler MAY emit W-KEY-001 warning for collections that contain objects." · §6.5.3 RULED S473: "`W-KEY-001` takes the header meaning: a collection of objects iterated with no header `key`".
